locations.label: Laboratory power room
locations.description: Open the ground-floor offices and take the first elevator to the War Room. Clear the route to its larger freight elevator and ride to the lowest floor, the laboratories. Coming out of that elevator, the power switch is in the second room on the left, marked with a large 3. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: War Room Jugger-Nog
locations.description: Buy Jugger-Nog in the lower War Room and keep a weapon with ammunition available nearby. The Box supplies the Winter’s Howl, Ray Gun and Monkey Bombs. Upgrading Winter’s Howl produces Winter’s Fury; there is no build or free-weapon quest for it here. Quick Revive gives three solo self-revives, while co-op use speeds up reviving teammates. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: DEFCON switches
locations.description: DEFCON begins at 1. Use the four switches in the War Room, in any order, to reach 5. Two are upstairs on the catwalk and two downstairs. Once DEFCON 5 is active, enter a teleporter to reach the Panic Room. Upper: to the left as you leave the first elevator. Upper: at the far end of the catwalk from that elevator. Lower: near the freight elevator to the laboratories. Lower: between Jugger-Nog and the later Mule Kick location. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Panic Room Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Pack-a-Punch costs 5,000 points in the Panic Room. The closed doors give a short window of roughly 30 seconds; finish and collect your weapon before they open and the machine closes. When everyone leaves, the room resets and the switches must be used again for another visit. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
